# niagara-tools

Shared tooling and knowledge base for Niagara N4 module development across `modulos_niagara_n4/Cliente/**` projects.

## Status

**Bootstrap placeholder.** Content will be generated by the `niagara-tools-bootstrap` SDD.

See planned scope in the engram memory `planned/niagara-tools-bootstrap` (or, once the SDD runs, the artifacts under `openspec/changes/niagara-tools-bootstrap/`).

## Planned MVP scope

- `README.md` + `CLAUDE.md` — quick start for humans and Claude agents
- `scripts/ng-deploy.sh` — canonical WSL → Windows station deploy wrapper (backup + build + copy + verify)
- `docs/GOTCHAS.md` + `docs/knowledge-base/bql-gotchas.md` — accumulated lessons (BQL gotchas, Slot-O-Matic regions, hot-reload rules, cache busters, etc.)

## Consumers

- `../Cliente/Honeywell/MX60/chihuahua/`
- Future Niagara modules under `../Cliente/**`
